projectDescription: Oden is a mobile-first point-of-sale system designed for restaurants and taquerías in Mexico, enabling order management, kitchen display, table control, and cash register operations from any iPhone or Android device.
keyFeatures: Mobile-first POS — works on any iPhone or Android without special hardware
Kitchen Display System (KDS) — orders routed to kitchen screens in real time
Offline-first operation with automatic sync when connectivity returns
Table management with drag-and-drop floor plan and real-time status
Split payments and partial refunds across multiple payment methods
Cash register with multi-cashier sessions and denomination counting
CFDI 4.0 electronic invoicing via QR code self-service
Public digital menu with QR code, customizable branding, and SEO
Thermal printer support (Star Micronics and Bluetooth printers)
Reports: daily sales, top products, payment breakdown, employee performance
publicApiSurface: Supabase Auth — email/password registration and login for restaurant owners
Employee PIN login — quick access for cashiers and waiters
Products API — create, update, and delete menu items with images and modifiers
Orders API — create orders, update status (DRAFT → COMPLETED → REFUNDED), apply split payments
Tables API — manage floor plan, table status, and reservations
KDS API — real-time order routing to kitchen stations
Cash Session API — open/close sessions, record movements, perform cash counts
Reports API — sales by period, top products, payment methods breakdown
Customers API — create and manage customer profiles and loyalty points
CFDI Edge Function — generate and send CFDI 4.0 invoices via email
Public Menu endpoint — SEO-friendly menu page per tenant
Push Notification service — order-ready and reservation-reminder alerts
WhatsApp Notification service — trial reminders and marketing templates
